author: phx reporter
title: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport marks volunteer program anniversary with new Doggie Director - PHX Reporter
text:
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport has highlighted milestones and community initiatives through a series of posts on its official Twitter account, including the election of a new Doggie Director and celebrations marking 25 years of its Navigator volunteer program.
On November 18, 2025, the airport announced, “Barking news–Navigator Buddy Finn has been elected as Airport’s next Doggie Director! Finn spreads paws-itivity by making sure no one is having a ruff time getting around #PHX. It’s part of the annual Community Service Fund Drive to raise money for local nonprofits. https://t.co/abjVCnjNZ8”. This event is part of an ongoing effort to engage travelers and support charitable causes at the airport.
The following day, on November 19, 2025, Phoenix Sky Harbor shared another milestone: “Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is marking 25 years of the Navigator volunteer program with a pop-up exhibit. See stories and photos in Terminal 4, Level 1 near Door 2 at the Phoenix Airport Museum. Learn more at https://t.co/udw0jCaiWh https://t.co/3NfWzBbjSv”. The pop-up exhibit aims to showcase the contributions of volunteers over the past quarter-century.
Later that same day, the airport continued its recognition efforts: “Phoenix Sky Harbor is celebrating 25 years of its Navigator volunteer program in 2025. We’re proud to feature longtime volunteers like Don Thomas, who has given more than 2,455 hours since joining in 2010. Learn more at https://t.co/saTqxAteQl https://t.co/5Pv5K6rFGX”.
These initiatives are part of Phoenix Sky Harbor’s broader community engagement efforts. In recent years, the airport has also expanded its services and management team. For example, Breeze Airways began operating flights from Phoenix to Charleston and Provo starting November 2022 as part of an expansion strategy (source). Additionally, Roxann Favors was appointed Assistant Director and Chief Revenue Officer for the City of Phoenix Aviation Department in August 2022 (source), while Jay DeWitt was named Assistant Director and Chief Development Officer responsible for planning and development functions (source).
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport continues to emphasize both operational growth and community involvement through programs like Navigator volunteers and special fundraising campaigns.
